# Command reference

Every verb on `/rupsha/move`, generated from `manifest/rupsha.yaml`. 
Where a verb runs is the whole design: **board** = one MAVLink message and the Pixhawk 
closes the loop; **host** = the Pi streams setpoints and checks abort every tick; 
**executive** = the autonomy executive; **meta** = reads and settings.

Companion MAVLink identity: sysid **245**, compid **191**; bench tools use sysid **246**. Firmware floor: **ArduRover 4.7.2** (`fb773567`, target `Pixhawk1`).

| verb | runs on | always available | fields (default) | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `arm` | board |  | `timeout` (10.0) | Arm. Refused below the firmware floor or while the board reports a pre-arm failure. |
| `disarm` | board | yes | `timeout` (10.0) | Disarm and confirm it on the heartbeat. |
| `stop` | board | yes | -- | Zero velocity, then HOLD, confirmed on the heartbeat. Always available. |
| `abort` | board | yes | -- | Cancel whatever runs, then stop. Always available. |
| `set_mode` | board |  | `target_name`, `timeout` (5.0) | Switch mode by name: MANUAL|ACRO|STEERING|HOLD|LOITER|AUTO|RTL|SMART_RTL|GUIDED. |
| `hold` | board |  | -- | HOLD mode (the board brakes and stays put). |
| `goto_gnss` | board |  | `lat`, `lon`, `radius` (2.0), `timeout` (120.0) | GUIDED to a lat/lon; the board's S-curve planner drives it. Resolves on arrival inside radius. |
| `goto_local` | board |  | `x`, `y`, `radius` (1.0), `timeout` (60.0) | GUIDED to a local north/east offset from the EKF origin. |
| `drive` | board |  | `distance`, `radius` (0.5), `timeout` (30.0) | GUIDED body-offset target `distance` m straight ahead (negative = behind). |
| `turn_to` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `heading`, `yaw_rate` (45.0), `timeout` (20.0) | Pivot in place to an absolute heading (host loop on yaw rate; board closes the rate loop). |
| `turn` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `angle`, `yaw_rate` (45.0), `timeout` (20.0) | Pivot by a relative angle, positive = clockwise. |
| `move_forward` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `duration`, `speed` (0.5) | Stream a forward body velocity for `duration` s. |
| `move_back` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `duration`, `speed` (0.5) | Stream a reverse body velocity for `duration` s. |
| `pivot` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `duration`, `yaw_rate` (30.0) | Spin in place at `yaw_rate` for `duration` s. |
| `arc` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `duration`, `speed`, `yaw_rate` | Stream speed + yaw rate together for `duration` s. |
| `search_spiral` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `radius` (15.0), `speed` (0.6), `target_name` (), `tag_id` (-1), `timeout` (180.0) | Archimedean spiral around the current position out to `radius`, until a target is seen or time runs out. |
| `vision_approach` | host @ 10 Hz |  | `target_name` (), `tag_id` (-1), `standoff` (2.0), `speed` (0.5), `timeout` (60.0) | Close on a tag or object until range <= standoff. Pixel- and range-native; never raises. |
| `set_ekf_source` | meta |  | `target_name` | Select the EKF3 source set: gps (set 1) | extnav (set 2). extnav needs rupsha_extnav.parm applied. |
| `set_origin` | meta |  | `lat`, `lon` | Set the EKF origin to lat/lon (GPS-denied start). |
| `led` | meta |  | `target_name` | URC indicator: autonomy (red) | teleop (blue) | arrived (flashing green) | off. |
| `wait` | meta |  | `duration` | Sleep `duration` s, abortable. |
| `add_position_leg` | executive |  | `lat`, `lon`, `radius` (3.0) | Queue a GNSS-only leg. |
| `add_marker_leg` | executive |  | `lat`, `lon`, `tag_id` (-1), `radius` (20.0) | Queue a leg that ends at an ArUco post; `radius` bounds the search. |
| `add_object_leg` | executive |  | `lat`, `lon`, `target_name`, `radius` (20.0) | Queue a leg that ends at an object (`target_name` = class); `radius` bounds the search. |
| `add_obstacle` | executive |  | `lat`, `lon`, `radius` | Declare a keep-out circle the executive routes around. |
| `clear_legs` | executive |  | -- | Drop every queued leg. |
| `clear_obstacles` | executive |  | -- | Drop every declared obstacle. |
| `start_autonomy` | executive |  | -- | Run the queued legs. |
| `disable_autonomy` | executive | yes | -- | Return the executive to Idle (the vehicle stops). |

## Fields

| field | type | unit | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | float32 | s | how long a timed host loop runs |
| `speed` | float32 | m/s | ground speed; sign is direction for timed moves |
| `yaw_rate` | float32 | deg/s | turn rate, positive = clockwise from above |
| `distance` | float32 | m | body-frame distance for drive() |
| `heading` | float32 | deg | absolute heading 0..360, 0 = north |
| `angle` | float32 | deg | relative turn, positive = clockwise |
| `lat` | float64 | deg | WGS84 latitude |
| `lon` | float64 | deg | WGS84 longitude |
| `x` | float32 | m | local north offset from the EKF origin |
| `y` | float32 | m | local east offset from the EKF origin |
| `radius` | float32 | m | acceptance or search radius |
| `standoff` | float32 | m | range to stop short of a target |
| `timeout` | float32 | s | verb budget; the verb resolves at or before it |
| `target_name` | string |  | mode name, tag label, object class, LED state, EKF source set |
| `tag_id` | int32 |  | ArUco id; -1 = any |

## `Outcome`

Terminal code of every verb (Move.Result.outcome).

| name | value |
|---|---|
| `SUCCEEDED` | 0 |
| `FAILED` | 1 |
| `DENIED` | 2 |
| `TIMEOUT` | 3 |
| `ABORTED` | 4 |
| `LOST` | 5 |
| `NOT_READY` | 6 |

## `AutonomyState`

The executive's state. Ordinals are wire values; the LED follows it.

| name | value |
|---|---|
| `IDLE` | 0 |
| `NAVIGATING` | 1 |
| `SEARCH_PATTERN` | 2 |
| `APPROACHING_MARKER` | 3 |
| `APPROACHING_OBJECT` | 4 |
| `VERIFYING_POSITION` | 5 |
| `VERIFYING_MARKER` | 6 |
| `VERIFYING_OBJECT` | 7 |
| `REVERSING` | 8 |
| `STUCK` | 9 |

## `LegType`

Kind of queued leg.

| name | value |
|---|---|
| `POSITION` | 0 |
| `MARKER` | 1 |
| `OBJECT` | 2 |

## `Display`

URC indicator state (rules -- red autonomous, blue teleop, flashing green arrived).

| name | value |
|---|---|
| `OFF` | 0 |
| `AUTONOMY` | 1 |
| `TELEOP` | 2 |
| `ARRIVED` | 3 |

## `/rupsha/state` (`RupshaState`)

NaN means absent. It never means zero.

| field | type | source |
|---|---|---|
| `armed` | bool | from HEARTBEAT base_mode |
| `mode` | string | RoverMode name, '' when unknown |
| `link_alive` | bool | a board HEARTBEAT within the last 2 s |
| `lat` | float64 | GLOBAL_POSITION_INT, deg |
| `lon` | float64 | GLOBAL_POSITION_INT, deg |
| `yaw_deg` | float32 | ATTITUDE yaw, 0..360 |
| `yaw_rate_dps` | float32 | ATTITUDE yawspeed, deg/s |
| `groundspeed` | float32 | VFR_HUD groundspeed, m/s |
| `battery_v` | float32 | SYS_STATUS voltage_battery; NaN when the board reports none |
| `gps_fix` | int8 | GPS_RAW_INT fix_type; -1 when absent |
| `gps_sats` | int8 | GPS_RAW_INT satellites_visible; -1 when absent |
| `ekf_ok` | bool | EKF_STATUS_REPORT attitude+velocity+horiz-pos-abs flags all set |
| `prearm_ok` | bool | SYS_STATUS health bit MAV_SYS_STATUS_PREARM_CHECK |
| `last_text` | string | latest STATUSTEXT from the board |
